grid.layout_notes: Sheet lists 5x3. Enhancer Cells sit above and below each reel (locked until opened). xWays / Razor Split can expand symbol heights and ways.

win_system.notes: xWays game. Exact base ways integer not printed on sheet; ways expand via xWays (stacked 4) and Razor Split doubling positions.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: Enhancer Cells can reveal xWays (same regular symbol stacked at 4) or Razor Split (doubles regular positions; top+bottom splits twice). Split Wilds split all regular symbols on the same reel.

other.name: Enhancer Cells
other.how_it_works: Locked cells on top and bottom of each reel. When opened, may reveal top-5 paying symbol, Wild, Razor Split, or xWays.

other.name: Jumping Wilds
other.how_it_works: In Lockdown Spins, Jumping Wilds move to a random regular reel position each spin; Razor Split enhancer can double their multiplier (max 512x) for the remainder of the feature.

wilds.name: Wild / Split Wild
wilds.behavior: Split Wilds can land on any reel in the main game; split all regular symbols on the same reel but not themselves. Bonus symbols that open enhancer cells also turn into wilds.

wilds.name: Jumping Wild
wilds.behavior: Awarded in Lockdown Spins (1/2/3 starting from 3/4/5 bonus symbols). Jumps each spin; Razor Split enhancer doubles multiplier (persists; max 512x).

scatters.name: Bonus symbol
scatters.behavior: 1 or 2 bonus symbols open the Enhancer Cell on that reel and turn the bonus into a wild. 3+ bonus symbols trigger Lockdown Spins.

specials.name: xWays (enhancer)
specials.behavior: Reveals the same regular paying symbols stacked at height 4.

specials.name: Razor Split (enhancer)
specials.behavior: Splits all regular positions into double; landing on both top and bottom splits twice.

base_game_loop.summary: Paid spin on a 5×3 xWays grid with locked Enhancer Cells above/below each reel. 1–2 Bonus symbols open that reel’s enhancer (and become wild); 3+ Bonuses trigger Lockdown Spins with 1–3 Jumping Wilds. Split Wilds can split a reel’s regulars. Optional buy into Lockdown with 3/4/5 Bonuses at 100×/400×/2000×.

phases.name: Spin
phases.what_happens: Reels stop on 5×3. Split Wilds may split regulars on their reel. Bonus symbols may land.

phases.name: Enhancer open (1–2 Bonus)
phases.what_happens: Each Bonus opens its reel’s Enhancer Cell (top/bottom) revealing top-5 pay / Wild / Razor Split / xWays, and the Bonus becomes wild.

phases.name: Evaluate ways wins
phases.what_happens: Pay left-to-right ways wins on the resulting grid.

phases.name: Lockdown trigger
phases.what_happens: 3, 4, or 5 Bonus symbols start Lockdown Spins with 1, 2, or 3 Jumping Wilds; enhancers stay open; spin count and a premium multiplier are revealed in enhancer cells before start.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Ways wins after Split Wild / enhancer expansions; Lockdown continues with Jumping Wild multipliers.
base_game_loop.notes: Psycho Manhunt caps at 150,000× and ends Lockdown when exceeded.

modes.name: Lockdown Spins
modes.trigger: Land 3, 4, or 5 Bonus symbols (awards 1, 2, or 3 starting Jumping Wilds respectively).
modes.spins_awarded: Spin count revealed in Enhancer Cells before the feature starts (not a fixed integer on the sheet).
modes.retrigger: Landing another Bonus symbol during Lockdown can add additional Jumping Wilds and spins.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Enhancer reels open and active for the whole feature. Jumping Wild multipliers doubled by Razor Split persist for the remainder of the feature (max 512x).
modes.progressive_state: Jumping Wild multipliers can increase via Razor Split enhancers during the feature.
modes.end_condition: Awarded spins complete, or total win hits Psycho Manhunt cap (150,000×) which ends Lockdown.

phases.name: Reveal setup
phases.what_happens: Enhancer cells reveal spin count and an additional multiplier on a random convict premium symbol; start with 1/2/3 Jumping Wilds from 3/4/5 Bonuses.

phases.name: Lockdown play
phases.what_happens: Each spin Jumping Wilds jump to random positions; enhancers can add Wilds/spins; Razor Split can double Jumping Wild multipliers (cap 512x).

phases.name: End / cap
phases.what_happens: Feature ends when spins run out or win reaches 150,000× base bet.

modes.effects: Enhancers active; Jumping Wilds; spin count pre-revealed; Bonus can add Wilds/spins; max Jumping Wild mult 512x; 150,000× ends feature.

bonus_free_spins.notes: Exact default spin counts per 3/4/5 Bonus trigger are revealed in-game via enhancers, not printed as fixed numbers on the affiliate sheet.

features.name: Enhancer Cells
features.effects: Open top/bottom cell: top-5 pay, Wild, Razor Split, or xWays (stack 4).

features.name: Split & Jumping Wilds
features.trigger: Split Wild in base; Jumping Wilds in Lockdown
features.effects: Split Wild splits regulars on its reel. Jumping Wilds jump each Lockdown spin; Razor Split doubles their mult up to 512x for the feature.

features.name: Psycho Manhunt
features.effects: Max payout 150,000× base bet; Lockdown Spins end when exceeded.

features.name: Nolimit Bonus (Feature Buy)
features.effects: Buy Lockdown Spins with 3, 4, or 5 Bonus symbols at 100×, 400×, or 2000× the bet.

options.name: Lockdown Spins — 3 Bonus
options.effects: Trigger Lockdown with 3 Bonus symbols (1 starting Jumping Wild).

options.name: Lockdown Spins — 4 Bonus
options.effects: Trigger Lockdown with 4 Bonus symbols (2 starting Jumping Wilds).

options.name: Lockdown Spins — 5 Bonus
options.effects: Trigger Lockdown with 5 Bonus symbols (3 starting Jumping Wilds).

feature_buy.notes: May be removed in some regulated markets (standard NLC disclaimer; not repeated on every San Quentin sheet line but applies to Nolimit Bonus).

numeric_limits.hit_frequency_notes: Hit frequency 34.25%; Lockdown Spins 1 in 230; win 100× 1 in 974.

## Enhancer Cells
On the top and bottom of each reel there is locked enhancer cell positions. When triggered to open they may reveal 1 of the top 5 paying symbols, Wild, Razor Split or xWays symbol. Razor split with split all regular positions into double, landing on top and bottom will split them twice. xWays symbol will all reveal the same regular paying symbols, stacked at 4.

## Bonus triggers
Land 1 or 2 bonus symbols will open the Enhancer cell on its respective reel, also turning the bonus symbol into a wild. Landing 3 or more bonus symbol will trigger the Lockdown Spins.

## Lockdown Spins
3, 4 or 5 bonus symbols will trigger Lockdown Spins with either 1, 2 or 3 starting Jumping Wilds.
